caption: The drawing features two detailed pencil sketches of a spoon on a beige background, displayed from different perspectives. The first view at the top shows the spoon from above, highlighting the oval-shaped bowl and the slightly flared, squared-off handle. The lower view presents the underside of the spoon, displaying the same oval bowl with a clear seam where the bowl and handle connect, as well as some engraved markings or hallmarks and initials "T V C" on the handle. Below these main views, there is a small rectangular inset drawing that provides diagrammatic measurements of the spoon: 7 1/8 inches in total length, 1 1/2 inches for the bowl width, and 3 7/8 inches for the handle section. The drawing has a thin, double-lined rectangular border and is signed in the lower right corner with the text "H. Viena." The entire composition is done in grayscale pencil with a soft shading style to indicate the metallic surface of the spoon.
title: Silver Spoon
